title: Add accessibility baseline for shared UI controls
description: Establish automated and manual WCAG 2.2 AA checks for shared buttons, inputs, labels, tables, status badges, loading, and error controls used across representative routes.
acceptanceCriteria: Shared controls expose accessible names/roles/states and associate validation errors programmatically
Keyboard users can reach and operate every interactive control with visible focus
Color is not the only status signal and loading/error states are announced or textually available
A representative route inventory is documented with pass/fail evidence and known exceptions

steps.description: Create a static/browser check for unlabeled icon buttons, invalid form association, color-only status, and hidden focus on representative shared components.
Read `apps/web/src/components/ui`, representative views, and locale catalogs; map controls and current accessibility attributes.
Add labels, roles, states, focus styles, error association, and text status without changing visual design unnecessarily.
Run static checks, typecheck, lint, and a browser keyboard/focus fixture in both locales when the runner is available.

technicalNotes: WCAG 2.2 AA requires evidence; do not infer conformance from the presence of an `aria-label` alone.
